notes: The upstream release asset is byte-identical to the copy Handheld Companion 1.3.1.6 bundles.
The installer states it may be redistributed unmodified. It refuses to install over an existing copy, so an older version is uninstalled first, and only with the tester's consent.
-unrestricted disables PawnIO's module signature check and is never passed.
Byte-identical to the RyzenSMU.bin Handheld Companion 1.3.1.6 embeds (HandheldCompanion.Resources.PawnIO.RyzenSMU.bin).
PawnIO verifies the module signature when it loads it; Device Lab also checks this digest first.
LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.6 embeds an older RyzenSMU.bin (SHA-256 0CF0FE12...D8AA) without the SMU command function; Device Lab uses that copy only through LHM's own read calls.
